item.title: How should Nuggets fill open roster spots for stretch run? David Adelman weighs in.
item.description: "Maybe you're looking at, we could use more ball-handling. Maybe you're looking at, we could use more size with the current injuries for the wing position."

item.title: Ilia Malinin’s stunning free skate secures US figure skating team gold at Milan Cortina Olympics
item.description: It seemed only fitting that Ilia Malinin was the first one to get his Olympic gold medal after the U.S. successfully defended its team title by holding off the Japanese on Sunday night in the three-day competition at the Milan Cortina Games.

item.title: Colorado takes struggling road show to top-25 foes at Texas Tech, BYU
item.description: The goal, every year, is to improve from week to week, from game to game. It has been an elusive goal this season for the Colorado men’s basketball team.

item.title: ‘Take the vaccine, please,’ a top US health official says in an appeal as measles cases rise
item.description: A leading U.S. health official on Sunday urged people to get inoculated against the measles at a time of outbreaks across several states and as the United States is at risk of losing its measles elimination status.

item.title: Jamal Murray participating in NBA 3-point contest at All-Star weekend
item.description: Murray is shooting 43.2% from 3-point range this season.

item.title: The Latest: Seahawks win second Super Bowl title
item.description: Super Bowl 60 is here, and it’s a rematch: The New England Patriots versus the Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Jade Masogayo, CU Buffs come through in crunch time, upset No. 14 TCU
item.description: Jade Masogayo was clutch down the stretch and converted a three-point play with 2.1 seconds left to lift the Buffaloes to an 80-79 upset of No. 14 TCU at the CU Events Center.

item.title: Bad Bunny brings Gaga, Martin and Puerto Rican pride to Super Bowl as Green Day, Puth play pregame
item.description: Stars have been front-and-center at Super Bowl 60, with Chris Pratt and Jon Bon Jovi introducing the teams, a series of soaring pre-game performances and a much-anticipated halftime show from Bad Bunny.
